5188.title: [release/4.152.x] Disable RAW and DNG image decoding
5188.body:
[release/4.152.x] Disable RAW and DNG image decoding (#5188)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/378
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162
Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/373
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/c44705eb6af2999f92c9437f098aa8d9be2b6970...ed63096f86c573cf06efc3565baf5b24d7290187

Remove built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX preview extraction from M152.
This is a deliberate loss of RAW support, not a replacement reader:
JPEG previews embedded in RAW containers are no longer extracted, while
standalone JPEG decoding remains available.

~~ Disable native RAW decoding consistently ~~

Skia's RAW target is gated by DNG SDK and PIEX flags. Set both false in
the shared GenerateGnBuild path so native platform builds inherit the
same policy. Drop conflicting platform overrides and the Alpine
__WORDSIZE define needed only by the DNG SDK. No C API exports,
generated bindings, or version increments change.

~~ Stop unused downloads and pin the merged native tree ~~

Disabling the codec does not stop fetching dng_sdk and piex while their
DEPS entries remain active. Consume the companion change commenting
them out and remove their Component Governance registrations.

Pin externals/skia and its manifest registration to native release merge
ed63096f86c573cf06efc3565baf5b24d7290187. Its tree matches reviewed head
457ae3f21b00651666daf98d152a085409707d6c. The macOS ARM64 source build
succeeded with both source trees absent; GN arguments, Ninja commands,
and the Skia/Skottie dependency graph exclude the RAW codec.

~~ Align callers and documentation with codec availability ~~

Remove the unsupported Gallery DNG choice and correct subsequent picker
indices. Move the original DNG media byte-for-byte into test content.
The regression verifies null file and managed-stream codec results with
Unimplemented, plus null SKData codec, bitmap, and image results.

Retain SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng = 10 for public ABI compatibility and
update build, dependency, and user guidance. The Gallery shared build
and focused DNG test passed.

The local unfiltered console suite had one ganesh-gl/DiagonalLines
golden mismatch: 1,832 pixels over tolerance, with 1,310 allowed.
Visual tests and goldens are unchanged. An untouched M151 base reproduced
the same images; an untouched M152 baseline was not run. No skips,
goldens, or tolerances were changed to hide the failure.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5157.title: [4.152] Backport AcesShared Apple CI and Xcode 26.3
5157.body:
[4.152] Backport AcesShared Apple CI and Xcode 26.3 (#5157)

Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5146

Backport the public Apple CI configuration from main to `release/4.152.x`.
This line has the same hosted `macos-15` defaults and 26.3/16.2
managed/native Xcode split as the source baseline, so retain both decisions
together.

~~ Move release/4.152.x macOS jobs to AcesShared ~~

`buildAgentMac` and `buildAgentMacNative` previously used `Azure Pipelines`
with `vmImage: macos-15`. Route both through `AcesShared` with
`ImageOverride -equals ACES_VM_SharedPool_Sequoia` so managed macOS work and
the native Apple stage share the same pool configuration.

~~ Align the native Xcode selector ~~

The common bootstrapper selects `XCODE_VERSION_NATIVE` for names beginning
with `native_`. The iOS, Mac Catalyst, macOS, and tvOS jobs take that path,
while managed macOS uses `XCODE_VERSION`. Raise the native pin from 16.2 to
26.3 so the release line no longer selects separate Apple compiler baselines.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
